"default" is the component as it is drawn today; the other variants are seeded from docs/COMPONENT-VARIANTS-PLAN.md and each wave (the component's "wave") refines and builds them. A pack listed in "built" must have the variant in its code (the variant prop, the bx-v-<id> class on the web) and its gallery (an element with data-variant="<id>" in the component's section); VariantsCoverageTest checks it. How to add one: target-packs/components/styles/README.md.
